Plot a tree with branches coloured by rate

Source: R/rates.R
plot_tree_rates.Rd

Plot a tree with branches coloured by rate

Usage

plot_tree_rates(
  tree,
  rates,
  lim = NULL,
  main = "Relative rate of evolution",
  ...
)

Arguments

tree

A phylo tree.

rates

Positive rates, one per edge in the order of tree$edge.

lim

Colour range on the log2 scale (rates from 2^-lim to 2^lim); by default symmetric around 1 and wide enough for all rates.

main

Title.

...

Further arguments to plot_tree_values().

Value

NULL, invisibly.
